query: WITH live AS (SELECT c.owner_id, count(*) AS n FROM sandbox_instances s JOIN conversations c ON c.id=s.conversation_id GROUP BY c.owner_id), queued AS (SELECT i.conversation_id, MIN(i.created_at) AS first FROM idempotency i WHERE i.execution_status='queued' GROUP BY i.conversation_id), waiting AS (SELECT w.conversation_id, c.owner_id, c.workspace_id, MIN(w.first) AS first FROM queued w JOIN conversations c ON c.id=w.conversation_id WHERE c.state='active' AND (c.profile->>'decision_engine' IS NULL OR c.profile->>'decision_engine' = ANY($2)) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sandbox_instances s WHERE s.conversation_id=w.conversation_id) GROUP BY w.conversation_id, c.owner_id, c.workspace_id) SELECT w.conversation_id AS "conversation_id!", w.owner_id AS "owner_id!", COALESCE(l.n,0) AS "live!", EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM waiting o LEFT JOIN live ol ON ol.owner_id=o.owner_id WHERE o.workspace_id=w.workspace_id AND o.conversation_id<>w.conversation_id AND o.first<w.first AND COALESCE(ol.n,0)<$3) AS "behind!", EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM conversations d JOIN templates t ON t.name=d.template WHERE d.id=w.conversation_id AND 'desktop'=ANY(t.capabilities)) AS "desktop!" FROM waiting w LEFT JOIN live l ON l.owner_id=w.owner_id ORDER BY COALESCE(l.n,0), w.first, w.conversation_id LIMIT $1
